cases.name: golden-not-certifying
cases.note: the honest current state: a real stance with certifies:false, ceiling FD0

cases.name: golden-certifying
cases.note: certifies at alpha; ceiling FD2 and never higher

cases.name: golden-abstained
cases.note: explicit signed abstention by a certifying seat; ceiling falls to FD0

cases.name: golden-precommitment-bound
cases.note: calibration bound to a precommitment atom; cross-check passes when the verifier holds it

cases.name: binding-well-formed-without-atom
cases.note: without the atom as input the binding verifies for well-formedness only — absence of the artifact is never an error

cases.name: binding-atom-mismatch
cases.note: verifier holds a different atom than the one bound

cases.name: tamper-ceiling-self-promoted
cases.note: validly re-signed by the issuer: a non-certifying seat claiming FD4. The signature is genuine; the claim is not

cases.name: tamper-ceiling-above-cap
cases.note: a certifying seat claiming FD3, above the FD2 cap

cases.name: tamper-abstained-with-distribution
cases.note: validly signed; abstention and distribution are mutually exclusive

cases.name: tamper-certifies-without-alpha
cases.note: validly signed; certifying requires a stated alpha

cases.name: tamper-corpus-not-published
cases.note: validly signed; an opaque calibration set is unfalsifiable, so the tree must name a published revision
